entities.name: Towser
entities.description: An egotistical wizard interested in astronomy and astrology living in Aerona on Dominaria, primary foe of Greensleeves and Gull.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Towser lives.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A foe of Towser who defeated him and took away his magic with the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: A foe of Towser who was hired into his traveling crew.

entities.name: Haley
entities.description: Towser's nurse who administers six potions a day.

entities.name: Dacian
entities.description: A rival wizard Towser battled outside White Ridge.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: A village destroyed in the battle between Towser and Dacian.

entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: Greensleeves' device for summoning bound spellcasters, which Towser planned to steal and copy.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A battle in which Greensleeves defeated Towser.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: The device Greensleeves used to take away Towser's gift of magic.

events.summary: In 4073 AR Towser follows a falling object to the Whispering Woods, meets Dacian outside White Ridge, and their battle destroys the village.
events.quote: engaged in a battle that resulted in the village's destruction

events.summary: Towser hires Gull to tend his livestock and wagons.
events.quote: he hired Gull as a member of his traveling crew

events.summary: Towser plans to kill Greensleeves by stealing and copying her Nova Pentacle.
events.quote: he planned to kill her by stealing and copying her Nova Pentacle

events.summary: After Greensleeves defeats him at the Battle of Lat-Nam, she uses the Stone Brain to take away his ability to do magic.
events.quote: she took away his gift of doing magic, rendering him a mere common man

relations.quote: He was the primary foe of Greensleeves and Gull .
he met the rival wizard Dacian
His nurse, Haley, administered six potions a day
Kakulina, his astrologer, shared his readings
